title: Text requests get a faster default
summary:
Text requests got a faster default, token checks got shorter, and model routing got more specific.

Text requests that omit a model now default to `openai-fast` instead of `openai`. Explicit model choices are unchanged.

Token validation now retrieves account details in one query instead of three; a test response fell from roughly 12 seconds to 2.1 seconds. Image generation also authenticates once per request rather than repeating the check.

Unfoldtech was added to Creative Projects. It turns Pexels images into prompt inspiration and embeds title, description, and keywords in downloaded images.

daily.title: A faster text default
daily.text: Omit `model` from a text request to use `openai-fast` by default. Explicit model selections still work as before. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Quicker token checks
daily.text: Token validation now uses one database query instead of three; a test response dropped from roughly 12 seconds to 2.1 seconds. Image requests also authenticate once rather than repeating the check.

daily.title: Model routing for configured accounts
daily.text: The new `openai-roblox` route supports text and image input plus tools for accounts configured to use it. Routing happens without a client change. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-roblox).
